items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five titled sections exist (h2 Personal details, Job and contract, Bank and tax information, Emergency contact, Documents) with visible <label for> above each field. But fields sit in a two-column grid ('grid grid-cols-1 ... sm:grid-cols-2'); first.png shows Preferred name beside Date of birth and Gender beside National ID. Not a single column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required labels get ' *' plus aria-required; header text states '* Required'; optional fields (Preferred name, Gender, Allowance) are unmarked. Document rows use * and an 'Optional' badge.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Dates w-40, tax code/national ID/phone w-56, salary w-56 right-aligned; type=date, type=email, type=tel used. No postal code field exists, but nothing contradicts the item.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: #save-draft 'Save draft' button; its handler only re-checks already-touched non-empty fields, does not call validateAll, shows 'Draft saved HH:MM', Draft badge and a toast.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: Bar 'sticky bottom-0' holding Cancel, Save draft, 'Create employee' (visible in first.png). The button is only disabled during the saving state (setSaving).

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: blur listener calls showError(f, check(f)); submit runs validateAll, renderSummary (for 3 or more errors) builds '<a data-jump>' links to each field, and focusErr(errs[0]) focuses the first invalid field.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: window beforeunload handler when dirty; in-app guard() opens #leave-dialog 'You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?' on Cancel and nav links.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Text 'Accepted: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each'; table rows show file name, size, and a Remove button (data-remove) with Preview and Download links; the Upload control is a native <button> and focus moves to Remove after upload; type and size are validated.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: Success panel title 'Employee NV-0248 <name> created' receives focus (tabindex -1), and toast() writes the same text into #toast-wrap role=status.

notes: Audit score 96; the only violation is table-above-fold, which does not apply to a form page. Layout is plain, restrained and flat (4px radii, slate neutrals, no gradients, glass, emoji or KPI tiles). Main defect: two-column field grid breaks the single-column requirement. Minor: the error summary shows only for 3 or more errors, and the money inputs carry a placeholder example (18.000.000) alongside a visible label.
